name: p3_remark2
statement: (k : ℕ) : p3_self_summable k ↔ Nat.fib k ∣ Nat.fib (Nat.fib k + 2) - 1
closed: ∀ (k : ℕ), p3_self_summable k ↔ Nat.fib k ∣ Nat.fib (Nat.fib k + 2) - 1
informal: k is self-summable iff F_k divides F_{F_k+2} - 1
original: It follows from Proposition 1 that the self-summable Fibonacci numbers are the integers $k$ such that $F_k\mid(F_{F_k+2}-1)$.
type: ∀ (k : ℕ), Mathlib2.p3_self_summable k ↔ Nat.fib k ∣ Nat.fib (Nat.fib k + 2) - 1
